WITH product_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        pc.product_type_description,
        AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as order_item_count
    FROM Products p
    LEFT JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
),
total_count_cte AS (
    SELECT SUM(order_item_count) as total_count
    FROM product_stats
),
product_stats_with_share AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.product_id,
        ps.product_type_description,
        ps.avg_quantity,
        ps.order_item_count,
        CASE 
            WHEN tc.total_count = 0 THEN 0
            WHEN tc.total_count IS NULL THEN 0
            ELSE CAST(ps.order_item_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / CAST(tc.total_count AS DECIMAL(19,4))
        END as share
    FROM product_stats ps
    CROSS JOIN total_count_cte tc
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        product_type_description,
        AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_avg_quantity,
        AVG(CAST(order_item_count AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_order_item_count,
        AVG(share) as avg_share
    FROM product_stats_with_share
    GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT 
    AVG(avg_avg_quantity) as overall_avg_quantity,
    AVG(avg_order_item_count) as overall_avg_order_item_count,
    AVG(avg_share) as overall_avg_share
FROM type_averages;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity in Order_Items is stored as VARCHAR but should be interpreted as numeric and cast to DECIMAL for averaging
